title: Truchas 2D flow model
description: The mesh-associated incompressible-flow model, including body acceleration, fluid-fraction controls, and flow boundary conditions.

inviscid.description: Use an inviscid flow model. The viscosity material property is not required in this mode.

unsteady-stokes.description: Use the unsteady Stokes equations, omitting momentum advection while retaining the transient, viscous, pressure, and body-force terms.

fluid-fraction-cutoff.description: Minimum mobile-fluid volume fraction for a cell to receive a flow equation. Must be strictly between zero and one.

min-face-fraction.description: Minimum nonzero interior face density as a fraction of the lightest real-fluid density. Must be greater than zero and no greater than one.

void-collapse.description: Two-sided pressure compliance for eligible trapped fluid/VOID cells. Omission disables collapse; geometric volume tracking is required.

pressure-time-scale.description: Positive impedance tau0*p0, with units of pressure times time.

reaction-cap.description: Maximum reaction coefficient as a multiple of the local pressure-diffusion diagonal.

capillary-coefficient.description: Effective surface tension c_sigma*sigma (pressure times length). Adds the pressure bias coefficient*(1-void_fraction)^3/sqrt(cell_area); zero retains unbiased compliance.

bc.description: Named flow boundary conditions. This sublist is required; if it is empty, the model supplies its default boundary treatment.
